about: JBC EXPRESS FREIGHT LLC, incorporated on 7th November 1992, an ISO 9001:2015 certified company, has deployed throughout the region with its full-fledged operation, terminals equipped with modern loading and storage facilities at Dubai, Jebel Ali Free Zone (South), Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ras Al Khaimah, Misfah - Oman. We cater cargo movement services to above 1500 satisfied customers in the region.

Project Logistics/Project Cargo can be defined as the transportation of large, heavy, high value or a critical piece of material or equipment intended specifically for a given project. At JBC we believe in the philosophy of “Any weight or Any value” is critical to a projects success.
